user.title: Connect to Peplink Router
user.description: Set up Peplink Local integration to monitor your Peplink router.

init.title: Peplink Options
init.description: Configure options for the Peplink integration. Pick the clients you want a device tracker for (for example phones for presence, or devices with no integration of their own). All connected clients are always listed in the Connected Clients sensor.

join_wifi.name: Join Wi-Fi network
join_wifi.description: Joins a Wi-Fi network on a Peplink Wi-Fi WAN. Target the WAN's Network select. Without an SSID it joins the network chosen in that select. Give the password for a new secured network; the router saves it for next time.

password.name: Password
password.description: Wi-Fi password. Leave empty for open networks and networks the router has already saved.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: Network to join. Leave empty to use the one chosen in the Network select.

forget_wifi.name: Forget Wi-Fi network
forget_wifi.description: Deletes a saved Wi-Fi network from the router (and disconnects if it is in use). Target the WAN's Network select.

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: Network to forget. Leave empty to use the one chosen in the Network select.
